findings.issue: なるべくしてなった asserts the event DID happen, inevitably. 'It should have happened.' in English implies it did NOT happen (unfulfilled expectation), flipping the meaning; it also contradicts the record's own lit_en and pt.
findings.suggested: It happened the way it was bound to.

findings.issue: ぴたり is mislabeled 'giseigo' (sound/voice mimetic). It describes a manner/state (stopping abruptly), so it is a gitaigo. Wrong classification taught to learners.
findings.current: ぴたり is an onomatopoeia/mimetic word (giseigo) that describes something stopping abruptly and completely
findings.suggested: ぴたり is a mimetic word (gitaigo) that describes something stopping abruptly and completely

findings.issue: Same misclassification as expl_en: ぴたり é rotulada 'giseigo' (mimética de som/voz), mas é uma mímese de estado/maneira (gitaigo).
findings.current: ぴたり é uma onomatopeia/mímese (giseigo) que descreve algo parando seca e completamente
findings.suggested: ぴたり é uma palavra mimética (gitaigo) que descreve algo parando seca e completamente

findings.issue: The quoted Japanese phrase is corrupted: the English word 'food' appears in place of 食べ物 inside the pt-BR explanation ('food にうるさい'). Learners cannot match this quote to the sentence.
findings.current: 'food にうるさい' ('chato/exigente com a comida') é uma qualidade
findings.suggested: 食べ物にうるさい ('chato/exigente com a comida') é uma qualidade

findings.issue: Corrupted Japanese quote: 'food にうるさい' substitutes the English word 'food' for 食べ物; the quote should reproduce the actual sentence text 食べ物にうるさい.
findings.current: 'food にうるさい' ('picky/fussy about food') is a quality
findings.suggested: 食べ物にうるさい ('picky/fussy about food') is a quality

findings.issue: Ungrammatical Portuguese: 'suaviza e cortês o pedido' is missing a verb (cortês is an adjective). The English version says 'softens and makes the request courteous'.
findings.current: A forma negativa interrogativa (ませんか) suaviza e cortês o pedido.
findings.suggested: A forma negativa interrogativa (ませんか) suaviza e torna o pedido mais cortês.

findings.issue: Typo in the English note of token 決して: 'decshite' should be the romanization 'kesshite' (the pt-BR note has it right).
